camel_example: aliyun edas DELETE /pop/v5/tag/tags --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceRegionId 'cn-beijing' --ResourceIds '["f5ad6ff7-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2axxxx82xxxx"]' --DeleteAll true --ResourceType application --TagKeys '["tagKey1","tagKey2"]' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Removes one or more tags from one or more resources
description_zh: 调用UntagResources接口为指定的资源列表统一解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun edas untag-resources --resource-region-id cn-beijing --resource-type application --resource-ids '["f5ad6ff7-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-2axxxx82xxxx"]' --tag-keys '["tagKey1","tagKey2"]' --delete-all true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The region in which the resource resides
parameters.name: resource_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

application: Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application

cluster: EDAS cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值：
application：EDAS应用。 
cluster：EDAS集群
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the resources from which you want to remove tags. You can specify up to 20 IDs
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The tags that you want to remove. You can specify up to 20 tags. Set this parameter to a JSON array
parameters.help_zh: 要解绑的标签键列表，列表的取值范围1~20，json数组格式
parameters.name: tag_keys

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all existing tags from the specified resources. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: removes all existing tags from the specified resources.

false: does not remove all existing tags from the specified resources.

All existing tags of a resource are removed only if the tagKeys parameter is left empty and the DeleteAll parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除选定资源下所有的用户标签，默认为false。

true：删除资源的标签。

false：不删除资源的标签。

仅当tagKeys为空，deleteAll=true时，才可以删除所有的客户标签
parameters.name: delete_all
